repos_data.description: Validate Nigerian postcodes in Rust, Python, JavaScript, Java, PostgreSQL, DuckDB, and Polars, with MCP servers for AI agents. Covers Nigeria's NIPOST digital postcode (NDAPS): offline validation, lookup, and reverse geocoding.
MCP server exposing Japan-specific utilities (era conversion, romaji, holidays, postal codes, kana, name split) to AI agents.
